limits: Native input/frame timing observes a private nested COSMIC composite framebuffer, including readback/poll overhead; not physical KMS scanout.
Nested compositor uses software rendering. Actual AMD engine activity is demonstrated separately in the GPU native-tree probe; a native-session AMD descriptor alone does not identify its renderer.
All eight standalone kinds are visible in the maximum fixture. Glance replaces Clock/Weather/Calendar; nine simultaneously visible kinds are not possible under the existing model.
Maximum desktop runs include changing system metrics at the default three-second interval, so their CPU/frame counts are active-work observations, not static-idle failures or static claims.
Weather and calendar remain disconnected; Music uses a private paused public-sample MPRIS service. No external provider requests or private user content.
Scene and color-analysis jobs share this worker bound. Other legacy media jobs and later aggregate asset limits remain separate.
Physical display/hotplug/mixed-GPU/suspend, accessibility devices, live providers and exact new package qualification remain FB20 release gates.
